An copycat as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 94 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
